subject: maths

concepts.title: Theoretical Probability of an Event
concepts.definition: The mathematical ratio of the count of favorable outcomes to the total count of all equally likely outcomes in a random experiment.
concepts.key_idea: Quantifies the likelihood of an event occurring when all outcomes have an identical chance of happening.
question_patterns: in Class 10 probability, find the probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed once
calculate the probability of drawing a red ball from a bag containing red and other balls
what is the probability of getting a number greater than 4 on a single die roll
determine the probability of selecting a girl as a class representative
how to compute the probability of drawing an ace from a deck of cards

solution_steps.action: Divide the number of favorable outcomes by the total number of outcomes
solution_steps.explain: Theoretical probability is the ratio of favorable outcomes to total possible outcomes.

concepts.title: Complementary Events
concepts.definition: A pair of events where one event occurs if and only if the other event does not occur, covering the entire sample space together.
concepts.key_idea: The sum of the probabilities of an event and its opposite is always exactly one.
question_patterns: if the probability of winning is given, find the probability of losing
calculate the probability of not getting an ace from a deck of cards
what is the probability of two friends having different birthdays
find the probability of not E when P(E) is known
determine the probability of drawing a non-defective pen when the probability of a defective one is given

solution_steps.action: Subtract the probability of the event from one
solution_steps.explain: The probability of the complement is one minus the probability of the event.

concepts.title: Impossible Events
concepts.definition: An event that contains no outcomes from the sample space and therefore can never occur during the experiment.
concepts.key_idea: An event that is completely impossible has a probability of zero.
question_patterns: what is the probability of getting a number 8 in a single throw of a die
find the probability of drawing a green marble from a box containing only red and blue marbles
calculate the probability of an event that is impossible to occur
explain why the probability of getting a sum of 13 on two dice is zero
determine the likelihood of an event that cannot happen

solution_steps.action: Identify the number of outcomes favorable to the impossible event
solution_steps.explain: Since the event cannot happen, there are zero favorable outcomes.

solution_steps.action: Conclude that the probability is zero
solution_steps.explain: Dividing zero by the total number of outcomes yields a probability of zero.

concepts.title: Sure or Certain Events
concepts.definition: An event that includes every possible outcome of the sample space, ensuring it will always happen.
concepts.key_idea: An event that is guaranteed to occur has a probability of one.
question_patterns: what is the probability of getting a number less than 7 in a single throw of a die
find the probability of drawing a red or blue ball from a bag containing only red and blue balls
calculate the probability of a sure event
explain why the probability of getting a sum less than or equal to 12 on two dice is one
determine the likelihood of an event that is guaranteed to occur

solution_steps.action: Identify the number of outcomes favorable to the sure event
solution_steps.explain: Since the event is guaranteed to happen, all possible outcomes are favorable.

solution_steps.action: Conclude that the probability is one
solution_steps.explain: Dividing the total number of outcomes by itself yields a probability of one.

concepts.title: Probability Range Bounds
concepts.definition: The fundamental rule stating that the probability value of any event must lie between zero and one, inclusive.
concepts.key_idea: Probabilities are never negative and never exceed one.
question_patterns: which of the following cannot be the probability of an event
can a negative number like -1.5 be the probability of an event
is it possible for the probability of an event to be 15 percent
explain why a probability cannot be greater than 1
verify if a given value can represent the probability of an event

solution_steps.action: Check if the given probability is less than zero or greater than one
solution_steps.explain: A valid probability must lie within the closed interval from zero to one.

solution_steps.action: Determine if the value is a valid probability
solution_steps.explain: If the value is negative or exceeds one, it cannot represent a probability.

concepts.title: Elementary Events and Sum of Probabilities
concepts.definition: An event that contains only a single outcome of the random experiment.
concepts.key_idea: Combining the probabilities of all distinct single-outcome events in a sample space yields exactly one.
question_patterns: what is the sum of the probabilities of all the elementary events of an experiment
define an elementary event and state the sum of their probabilities
verify that the sum of probabilities of getting a head and getting a tail is 1
explain why the individual outcomes of drawing a ball from a bag sum to 1
show that the sum of probabilities of all outcomes of a die is 1

solution_steps.action: Identify all elementary events in the experiment
solution_steps.explain: Each elementary event corresponds to exactly one unique outcome.

solution_steps.action: Sum the probabilities of all these elementary events
solution_steps.explain: The sum of the probabilities of all elementary events is always equal to one.

concepts.title: Geometric Probability in One Dimension
concepts.definition: The probability of a random point landing in a specific sub-interval, calculated using the ratio of lengths.
concepts.key_idea: Probability is determined by the ratio of the favorable segment length to the total available length.
question_patterns: find the probability that the music will stop within the first half-minute in a two-minute interval
calculate the probability of a point falling in a specific segment of a line
what is the probability that a randomly chosen time in a 2 minute game is in the first 30 seconds
determine the 1D geometric probability of an event
how to find the probability based on lengths of intervals

solution_steps.action: Divide the favorable interval length by the total interval length
solution_steps.explain: Geometric probability in 1D is the ratio of the favorable length to the total length.

concepts.title: Geometric Probability in Two Dimensions
concepts.definition: The probability of a random point falling inside a specific sub-region, calculated using the ratio of areas.
concepts.key_idea: Probability is determined by the ratio of the favorable region area to the total region area.
question_patterns: what is the probability that a helicopter crashed inside a lake of a rectangular region
calculate the probability of a die landing inside a circle of diameter 1m placed in a rectangle
find the 2D geometric probability of landing in a target area
determine the probability of hitting a circular region inside a rectangular board
how to compute the probability of a random point being inside a specific sub-region

solution_steps.action: Divide the favorable region area by the total region area
solution_steps.explain: Geometric probability in 2D is the ratio of the favorable area to the total area.

concepts.title: Probability of Combined Outcomes of Two Dice
concepts.definition: The probability of events involving the simultaneous roll of two independent six-sided dice, which has thirty-six possible outcomes.
concepts.key_idea: The total number of outcomes is thirty-six, and we count the pairs that satisfy the given condition.
question_patterns: in Class 10 probability, find the probability that the sum of the two numbers appearing on top of two dice is 8
calculate the probability of getting a sum of 13 when two dice are thrown
what is the probability that the sum of numbers on two dice is less than or equal to 12
determine the probability of getting a specific sum on throwing two dice
how to find the probability of a sum of two dice being a certain value

solution_steps.action: Divide the number of favorable pairs by thirty-six
solution_steps.explain: The total number of outcomes when throwing two dice is thirty-six.
